summary: Backend and data work with data-science and backend teams: scrapers, ETL pipelines and the Linux and AWS infrastructure that runs them.
achievements: Rebuilt a scraper-based ETL: from about 5k records in nearly 2 hours to 200k in 6, on four Docker instances.
Optimized an ETL that took almost 4 hours and over 60 GB of RAM: it now runs in at most 1 hour and 40 GB.
Build and operate Python and TypeScript services backed by SQL, on Linux servers and AWS.
